chunks: Ali ibn Ri'ab narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:
Any man upon whom multiple hudud have been established, among which is execution, the punishments less than death are to be carried out first, then he is executed after that.

key_terms.حُدُودٌ: fixed legal punishments prescribed in the Sacred Law
key_terms.يُبْدَأُ: the order begins with; carried out first

ai.seo_question: If several hudud apply to a man and one of them is execution, which punishment is carried out first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about the order of carrying out multiple legal punishments when one of them is death. It states that the lesser hudud are implemented first, and only afterward is the death penalty carried out.
